function.name: execute
function.arguments: {"command":"python -c \"import pandas as p; d=p.read_csv('/measurements.csv'); d['bin']=d.time_s.astype(int); print(d.groupby('bin').agg(n=('time_s','size'),wmean=('correlation_width','mean'),wmed=('correlation_width','median'),smean=('mean_shear_magnitude','mean'),wstd=('correlation_width','std')).to_string()); print('first/last width',d.correlation_width.iloc[0],d.correlation_width.iloc[-1]); print('width plateau-ish max/min bins',d.groupby('bin').correlation_width.mean().to_dict())\""}
